findings.claim: Candidate is a distinct Huihui v2 fine-tune based on Qwen3.8 Flash-Next, not duplicate Q26 Unsloth.
findings.evidence: HF pinned revision and local search by exact shard/model names; no candidate files found locally.

findings.claim: Strata dual/multi-GPU path is technically relevant but external speed is not transferable.
findings.evidence: Official release v0.2.6 uses Qwen engine 0.1.50; issue #2129 uses base UD-IQ4_XS on 4 GPUs, including two RTX3090, and explicitly reports no correctness suite. Local comparison is still needed.

findings.claim: Candidate has a material safety-risk tag.
findings.evidence: HF repository tags include abliterated and uncensored; Q153 includes Tool-Eval Hard Mode safety/injection/governance cases with immediate no-go gate.

decision: Actionable: preregister dual-3090 evaluation; external evidence cannot decide adoption. Do not infer safety or quality from the author/community speed claims.
